data.reason: This fixes an IndexOutOfRangeException crash when accessing DeclaringSyntaxReferences on metadata symbols (types from referenced assemblies), replacing direct array indexing with a safe helper method that uses FirstOrDefault(), which is one of the three crash points identified in the bug report.
